pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions (pyramiding) within 30 seconds or 5 dollars of an existing trade to prevent compounding exposure into localized falling knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 3-bar multi-timeframe volume confirmation and an explicit ATR-based spread check before order execution is authorized.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing stop-locks and sentinel harvest whenever floating profit crosses $12.00 to prevent erosion of green runs.
